snippet.title: Forefront 1.0 | Announcement Trailer 💥
snippet.description:
Forefront received plenty of exciting updates in Early Access. Two new maps (with a third later this week), three new vehicles, four new gadgets, a whole host of improvements, and much more.

We're proud to announce Forefront 1.0 launches April 23rd 2026, at a final price tag of $27.99! Get ready for a bunch of new content, another new map, and new PCVR improvements!

Get in for less while you still can, and enjoy when Fjord drops later this week!

For more information, check: https://www.forefrontvr.com
